ctx.x: Anyway, we were handing things up to...cases... suitcases up to the bus driver to put them away. "Here, Joe..." His name was Joe. "Here, Joe," DING. So here we got loaded, and leaving town. At the edge of town there was a railroad crossing, and we stop at the crossing... And after we pass the railroad crossing, here comes the deputy sheriff up. He stops us and says, "You was speedin'." He says, "How could I be speeding when I just starting up the bus?" He said, "Yeah, you was speeding across that pit(?). It's…

Boy, if I could have had something, I would have really done him in! I guess it's a good thing I didn't have anything. I said, "Well, this ain't no place for me to be, down here, because I'll get myself really in trouble," you know, by people being so rotten like that.
